verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Unity Catalog enforces access control on every data/AI interaction and that agents get 'governed access' to third-party tools (Slack, GitHub, etc.) via MCP services and Unity Catalog functions, implying some level of permissioned, least-privilege tool access for agents. However, there is no explicit documentation of issuing scoped/least-privilege API credentials (e.g., service principals, OAuth token scopes, PAT scoping) specifically for an agent's own API calls. Missing for 10: explicit service-principal or OAuth-scope credential-issuance workflow for agents, documentation of credential scope granularity, and any hands-on/independent confirmation.
